key_exclusions: must cancel and rebook (in-place fare adjustment not allowed)
policy_text_full: American Airlines lets customers cancel and rebook at a lower fare within 24 hours of booking. Refund is issued to original tender upon cancellation. Same flow as Delta — in-place fare adjustment is not supported.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 24 hours of booking, customers can cancel and rebook at a lower fare; refund is issued to original tender on cancellation.
